title: ASGN Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: ASGN Incorporated changed its corporate name to Everforth, Inc. effective April 24, 2026, pursuant to a certificate of amendment filed with the Delaware Secretary of State on April 22, 2026. The company's common stock will cease trading under ticker symbol ASGN and begin trading under new ticker EFOR on the New York Stock Exchange. The name change was approved by the Board of Directors without requiring a stockholder vote under Delaware law.
key_points: ASGN Incorporated formally changed its corporate name to Everforth, Inc. on April 24, 2026
The certificate of amendment was filed with the Delaware Secretary of State on April 22, 2026
Board of Directors approved the name change pursuant to Section 242 of the DGCL without requiring stockholder approval
The ticker symbol changed from ASGN to EFOR on NYSE effective April 24, 2026
The company's common stock is listed on NYSE under the new ticker symbol EFOR
Bylaws were amended to reflect the corporate name change only; no other substantive changes were made
